must_haves: security and where data is stored (Stockholm)

layout.idea: FAQ as the page: short hero, then every question as an H2 with its answer open (no accordion), grouped Setup, Safety, Teams, Billing.
layout.why: Objections decide this purchase; a page that is mostly answers respects that.

hero.idea: A real Claude conversation screenshot: the user asks for the unpaid invoices in invoices@ and gets a short list plus drafted reminders.
hero.why: A business task on a shared address speaks to the team half of customers.

visual_style.idea: Ledger lines: pricing and spec tables on faint horizontal rules like a ledger, numbers in tabular figures, cobalt totals.
visual_style.why: Fits teams running invoices@ and keeps tables readable.

typography.idea: Spectral 300 italic for large display lines, Work Sans 400/500 body.

narrative.idea: Built for the long haul: no lock-in, revoke in one click, your mail never leaves your provider's storage.
narrative.why: Low commitment lowers the fear of trying it.

proof.idea: Full pricing table on the homepage, including Business per person, with no 'contact us' gate.
proof.why: Transparency is proof of good faith.

asset_use.idea: Small 3D envelope renders used as step markers (1, 2, 3) in place of icons.
asset_use.why: Ownable markers instead of generic icons.

motion.idea: Linked FAQ answers get a brief cobalt-soft background flash when reached by anchor.
motion.why: Helps people land on the right answer.

section_order.idea: Index > 01 What it is > 02 Providers > 03 Clients > 04 Security > 05 Approval > 06 Plans > 07 Questions
section_order.why: Manual order, easy to jump around.

voice.idea: Business-plain for teams. Sample: 'Give the AI the invoices@ inbox. Keep the approve button for yourself.'
voice.why: Speaks to owners delegating shared inboxes.

wildcard.idea: Every section is an email: each one has a From / To / Subject / Date header block and a body.
wildcard.why: The product's medium becomes the page's grammar.
